purpose: Freeze the second strict NVOS relation-feature candidate after the query-independent hash diagnostic failed its two-sentinel non-regression gate, before any PCA40 selector is rendered or scored on a target view.

candidate.name: strict raw-scribble C-RADIO DINOv3 primitive PCA40 relation diagnostic
candidate.track: raw signed scribbles -> exact adjoint -> balanced weighted logistic unary -> query-conditioned diffusion
candidate.relation_source: official frozen C-RADIOv4 dino_v3_7b feature_projection rows from the canonical field

pca40_transform.fit_population: all and only canonical capability-valid primitive rows in ascending global-row order
pca40_transform.input_dtype: stored float16 converted to float32 before statistics
pca40_transform.standardization: per-dimension scene mean and sample standard deviation with correction=1, matching torch.std default in the release
pca40_transform.implementation: sklearn.decomposition.PCA with release-default svd_solver=auto and global NumPy seed 0
pca40_transform.subsample_rule: if valid rows exceed 500000, np.random.choice without replacement after np.random.seed(0); otherwise all valid rows
pca40_transform.projection: center standardized rows by fitted PCA mean and right-multiply by PCA components transpose
pca40_transform.eigenvalue_weighting: multiply each projected component by the fitted PCA singular value, matching dif_NVOS eigval_weighting=True
pca40_transform.graph_input_normalization: per-primitive L2 normalization with eps=1e-8 before relation distances

diffusion.kernel: released N-by-K positional normalization, symmetrization, and per-iteration feature-column normalization

candidate.immutable_hyperparameter_rule: Do not tune f, g, K, logistic C, diffusion iterations, or threshold using fern or horns_left target labels.

compatibility_boundary.reason: LUDVIG fits PCA40 on standardized 1536-D native DINOv2 ViT-g image patch tokens before inverse-render uplift. This candidate instead fits standardized PCA40 on already-uplifted 4096-D official C-RADIO DINOv3 primitive rows, which are stored L2-normalized and float16-quantized.
compatibility_boundary.allowed_claim: query-independent C-RADIO DINOv3 primitive PCA40 relation diagnostic with LUDVIG-inspired transform semantics

native_semantics: The last of four requested DINOv2 intermediate layers supplies 1536-D patch tokens.
All scene-view patch tokens are accumulated before PCA; each channel is centered and divided by torch's sample standard deviation.
At most 500000 standardized tokens are sampled without replacement for PCA fitting; NumPy is seeded by the run seed.
sklearn PCA40 centers again by its fitted mean and projects with components transpose.
dif_NVOS multiplies PCA components by PCA singular values before bilinear image upsampling and inverse-render uplift.
dif_NVOS does not enable the optional post-uplift L2 normalization, but GraphDiffusion L2-normalizes each primitive immediately before logistic fitting and graph distances.

sentinel_plan.gate: strict macro improves by at least 0.03 over frozen compact unary, at least one sentinel improves, and neither regresses by more than 0.03
